comment:
* Interface representing {@link android.webkit.WebViewFactoryProvider}. On device with a compatible
 * WebView APK this interface is implemented by a class defined in the WebView APK itself. On
 * devices without a compatible WebView APK this interface is implemented by a stub class {@link
 * androidx.webkit.internal.IncompatibleApkWebViewProviderFactory}.

methods.name: WebViewBuilderBoundaryInterface getWebViewBuilder()
methods.comment: Returns a builder that can configure and build a WebView instance.

methods.name: WebViewProviderBoundaryInterface createWebView(@NonNull WebView webview)
methods.comment: Create a support library version of {@link android.webkit.WebViewProvider}.

methods.name: WebkitToCompatConverterBoundaryInterface getWebkitToCompatConverter()
methods.comment:
* Create the boundary interface for {@link WebkitToCompatConverter} which converts
     * android.webkit classes into their corresponding support library classes.

methods.name: String @NonNull [] getWebViewFeatures()
methods.comment: Fetch the features supported by the current WebView APK.

methods.name: ServiceWorkerControllerBoundaryInterface getServiceWorkerController()
methods.comment: Fetch the boundary interface representing {@link android.webkit.ServiceWorkerController}.

methods.name: TracingControllerBoundaryInterface getTracingController()
methods.comment: Fetch the boundary interface representing {@link TracingController}.

methods.name: ProxyControllerBoundaryInterface getProxyController()
methods.comment: Fetch the boundary interface representing {@link android.webkit.ProxyController}.

methods.name: DropDataContentProviderBoundaryInterface getDropDataProvider()
methods.comment: Fetch the boundary interface representing image drag drop implementation.

methods.name: ProfileStoreBoundaryInterface getProfileStore()
